description: Connection interrupted measures commands, not time: shown when the usercmd made 127 commands ago is newer than the last one the server acknowledged (nextSnap->ps.commandTime). One command per client frame makes the warning window 127 frames: about 1 s at 125 FPS, 254 ms at 500, 127 ms at 1000, so high frame rates show it on healthy connections. While the player is not simulating (kill cam, final kill cam) commandTime stops advancing and the window drains even faster.
evidence: CG_DrawDisconnect: CL_GetUserCmd(CL_GetCurrentCmdNumber() - 0x7F); shown if nextSnap->ps.commandTime < cmd.serverTime <= cg.time. CL_CreateNewCommands (004EF7A0): cmdNumber++ into a 128-entry ring (& 0x7F). Store build: CG_DrawDisconnect 1400DA680, CL_CreateNewCommands 1401954D0 (match.py). To confirm in reconstruction: CL_SendCmd (004EC0A0) creates one command per frame, and whether the wrapped ring also costs real command redundancy in CL_WritePacket (004FCB30). Players report it clears when capped at 120 FPS.
